title: Aether-Flux Secret Propagation, UART Lockdown Semantics, and Wear-Aware Flash Memory Management in Kotlin
topic: A story of WiFi secrets, UART lockdowns and a damaged flash memory chip

abstract: We present a lightweight, lock-free Kotlin library that couples a UART state machine with a wear-aware flash memory model. The design enforces a linearizable send/receive protocol and a monotonic wear counter, guaranteeing that no write exceeds the prescribed wear budget. Formal invariants are proven using a simple atomic state machine and a bounded-buffer abstraction. Static analysis of the source yields an $O(1)$ amortized enqueue and $O(1)$ dequeue under contention, with an auxiliary memory bound of $O(N)$. The implementation is fully verified against the provided flash-memory and UART specifications, and the source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/kotlin-systems-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261016_170132_a_story_of_wifi_secrets__uart}.
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints
